noImplicitReturns.description: Require a Returns<Value, Error> return annotation on user-written functions with inferred throws or rejections. Separate from compilerOptions.noImplicitReturns.

noUnhandledRootErrors.description: Report inferred throws and promise rejections escaping module/script execution, including unknown/any effects from unmodelled external implementations.

noUnhandledPromises.description: Report potentially rejecting promises left unhandled in any scope, including function and callback bodies. Return, await, or attach a rejection handler to the promise.
